expectations.assertion: Derives the neutrals (borders, hover washes, inputs) from a single ink color at fixed alphas rather than introducing multiple greys
expectations.reason: Every neutral is `color-mix` of `--ink` at fixed alphas (12% line, 5% wash, 14% field, 62% secondary text), and the transcript states there is no second grey.

expectations.assertion: Gives the card continuous-curvature (squircle) corners and makes the button a pill
expectations.reason: The card uses `corner-shape: squircle`, and the button has `rounded-full`, which is a pill.

expectations.assertion: Names a spring from the seven-spring vocabulary (PANEL for the dropdown) instead of an ad-hoc duration or a new spring
expectations.reason: The transcript defines its own 'one spring' as a custom `linear()` curve at 420ms, never names PANEL or any vocabulary spring, and says the reference files were blocked, so it is the ad-hoc spring this expectation rules out.

expectations.assertion: Keeps font weights at 500 or below and uses sentence-case copy on the button
expectations.reason: Weights used are 300, 400 and 500 (`font-light`, `font-normal`, `font-medium`), and the button reads 'Change plan' in sentence case.

expectations.assertion: Does NOT ship a stock shadcn rounded-lg rectangle unchanged for the card surface
expectations.reason: The card surface is a custom `squircle` section with a 28px radius, a two-layer recessed layout and a custom ring shadow, not a default shadcn `rounded-lg` card.
